name: Marketing and Labeling
purpose: GRI 417: Marketing and Labeling 2016 contains disclosures for organizations to report information about their impacts related to marketing and labeling, and how they manage these impacts. The Standard is structured as follows: • Section 1 contains a requirement, which provides information about how the organization manages its marketing and labeling-related impacts. • Section 2 contains three disclosures, which provide information about the organization’s marketing and labeling- related impacts.
